consensus_points.summary: Substring-grep JSON inspection (`raw.contains("\"change_class_id\"")`, `raw.contains("\"meta_review_triggered\": true")`, the `||` for whitespace variants) is the central technical defect. Identified from 6 independent lenses.

per_lens_framing.F1_linus: special case caused by refusing to parse JSON; `||` whitespace variants is the smell that proves data shape is wrong
per_lens_framing.F2_hyperscaler: N * P byte-scans where P = predicate count; no parsed-evidence memoization across sub-checks; spec drift inevitable
per_lens_framing.F6_alternatives: Linus-style serde_json alternative deferred to F-LANE-SEAM-IMPL-FULL-JSON but not named inline as rejected
per_lens_framing.F7_security: string-matching-trivial-bypass; whitespace variants, case variants, embedded string occurrences
per_lens_framing.F8_performance: copy-introduced where zero-copy was feasible; O(N × file_size) heap allocation

consensus_points.severity_blocking_for_ramp: HIGH — must resolve before any sub-check promotes from ReportOnly to Error

consensus_points.summary: Pervasive `if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(...)` + `filter_map(Result::ok)` silently drops I/O errors. A check lane whose job is to surface conditions cannot fail-open as zero-count.

per_lens_framing.F5_quality: silent-data-drop pattern in a check lane whose job is to surface conditions
per_lens_framing.F7_security: fail-open-on-error; permissions/transient ENOENT/FS corruption yields counters=0 + green ReportOnly
per_lens_framing.F9_compliance: audit-chain emission required for state changes — sub-check-level findings not emitted

consensus_points.summary: check_naming_convention returns Pass/Fail; the other 3 always return NotYetArmed regardless of count. The premise 'uniform day-1 stubs' is not held by the code itself.

per_lens_framing.F4_ergonomic: copy-paste hazard: SubCheckStatus::Pass instead of NotYetArmed for a stub compiles + passes test
per_lens_framing.M1_challenge_assumption: premise of 'uniform day-1 stubs' isn't held by impl — ceremony risk

consensus_points.summary: check_naming_convention silently caps violations.push at 10 with no '… N more' finding. Signal saturates before the repo does.

All four fixture-pair directories contain only README stub files. fixture-pair-coverage sub-check today asserts only directory presence; the day-1 'F3 fixture pair' acceptance gate is met syntactically but NOT semantically.
consensus_points.severity_blocking_for_ramp: HIGH — fixture pair must contain real passing+failing data before sub-check promotes to Error

consensus_points.summary: None of the four new sub-check fns has a dedicated unit test. The canonical-IDs test (run_composite_returns_ten_sub_checks) asserts wiring only — not behavior. Existing adversarial tests cover seam-imports + change-class-declared only.
No criterion bench; no regression baseline; serial single-threaded scan at 100x evidence/PR count becomes the long pole of CI.

Extension allow-list, canonical-home list, scorecard required-keys, meta-trigger key — all are policy data inlined as code literals. Canonical source lives in specs/multispectrum-review.json + P14/P15. Drift inevitable.

ADR-0069 requires audit-chain emission for state changes. The task_group_completion event names sub-checks collectively but emits no per-sub-check who/when/what/why. Compliance team cannot reconstruct findings from chain alone.
consensus_points.severity_blocking_for_ramp: MEDIUM — depends on ADR-0069 scope interpretation

consensus_points.summary: check_naming_convention enforces P14 BNF naming-governance — orthogonal to dependency-seam discipline. At 1-year zoom should migrate to oya-check-naming.

Three of four sub-checks return NotYetArmed unconditionally. They DOCUMENT intent but ENFORCE nothing. The premise 'these are day-1 stubs that will arm' assumes the gap closes — without sunset dates on the 4 FixupTasks, NotYetArmed can drift into permanence (coverage-illusion).
consensus_points.severity_blocking_for_ramp: HIGH — prevention: file F-FIXUPTASK-SUNSET-DATES + open spec ticket per M1's recommendation
